Class DefaultRouteAnnotations

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.DefaultRouteAnnotations
@Internal public final class DefaultRouteAnnotations extends Object
The annotations given to a handler route or a group of routes with RouteSpec.annotate(AnnotationValue) and RouteSpec.annotate(AnnotationValue): the members of a later annotation of a type are merged with, and override, the ones of an earlier annotation of the same type, like Element#annotate, and a repeatable annotation is added to the earlier ones. The stereotypes of an annotation are the ones of its value: the meta-annotations of an annotation type are not known at runtime.

The annotations of a route are layered like the annotations of a controller method over the ones of its class: the annotations of the element given with RouteSpec.annotationMetadata(AnnotationMetadataProvider), then of the groups of the route, outer group first, then of the route, each overriding the members of the same annotation before it.
